label_rationale: phase is set to CLOSED before the payout call, so bid() reverts inside the window
mechanism: auction house: proceeds are paid to the seller when the auction closes
arm_reason: a state-changing callback with a user/frozen target; the general assume-guarantee arm applies

closure.justification: functions whose read/write effects intersect the proof footprint ['escrow', 'phase']

composition.rule: admissible callbacks preserve I_exp; the post-phase restores I_stable, which implies phi

Assume-Guarantee specification for AuctionHouse_PH01b
  target property phi : phase != CLOSED || escrow == 0
  exposure site       : close.call  (low-level call)
  ghost state         : (none)

  [A_cb]  ASSUMPTION
          During close's exposed phase, re-entrant control is confined to the
          callback closure ['bid', 'close']; every such callback is admitted by the
          protocol, with bounded depth-one nesting.
          discharged by: conservative-closure soundness gate (static, not the LLM)

  [G_pre] GUARANTEE
          {(phase == OPEN || phase == CLOSED) && (phase != CLOSED || escrow == 0)} pre-phase {phase == CLOSED && escrow == 0}
          discharged by: OBL_pre

  [G_exp] GUARANTEE
          forall f in A_cb. {I_exp} f {I_exp}   (I_exp = phase == CLOSED && escrow == 0)
          discharged by: ['OBL_cb_bid', 'OBL_cb_close']

  [G_post] GUARANTEE
          {I_exp} post-phase {(phase == OPEN || phase == CLOSED) && (phase != CLOSED || escrow == 0) /\ true}
          discharged by: OBL_post

  COMPOSITION THEOREM (instance):
    A_cb => (G_pre /\ G_exp /\ G_post) => phase != CLOSED || escrow == 0
      where callbacks are confined to admissible_callbacks=['bid', 'close'], depth-one

obligations.purpose: callback bid preserves I_exp (depth-one) or is excluded by its guard during exposure
obligations.excluded: guard unsatisfiable during exposure (callback excluded from the admissible set)

obligations.purpose: callback close preserves I_exp (depth-one) or is excluded by its guard during exposure
obligations.excluded: guard unsatisfiable during exposure (callback excluded from the admissible set)
